info.title: LIBRA Core internal Media binding contract
info.description: Milestone 7 Core receiver; actual Media caller is separate work. Private network; Nginx public path is blocked. Disabled by default. Pin distinct RSA key and kid; RS256, issuer libra-media-services, subject libra-media, sole audience libra-core-internal, purpose service-access, nonblank jti, required iat/exp, no future iat, strictly future exp, lifetime <=60 seconds, zero leeway. Scope media.bindings:read. Browser cookies/playback tickets are rejected. Reads do not grant playback or accept readiness. See docs/core-integration-operations.md.

get.summary: Read exact Core-owned binding and candidate/active references

200.description: Known binding; retired bindings can have both flags false; no-store

mediaServiceBearer.description: Dedicated pinned Media RSA key; scope media.bindings:read.

Problem.description: Problem Details: 400 invalid input; 401 missing/invalid/live-revoked credentials; 403 insufficient role/scope or missing CSRF; 404 missing target; 409 invalid state, stale version or idempotency conflict; 500 internal failure. Error details omit payloads and exception text.
